description: Active provider-backed workflow-session registry. It is empty: every prior corpus was archived before rerun, and no session has been executed under the Lifecycle V2 contract.
append_policy: Add one immutable schema-v2 workflow_session record only when a future corrected-contract provider baseline or treatment actually executes. Archived historical sessions remain under sources/evaluations/archive and are not active controls.

baseline_pool.identity_policy: frozen-protocol-and-replicate; execution date is metadata only

install.policy: Run Codex from a fresh lane-specific CODEX_HOME with auth only, no MCP servers, no global instructions, no hooks, no skills/plugins, isolated HOME/PYTHONUSERBASE/XDG/TMPDIR, and a preflight artifact proving empty MCP config.

reset.policy: Delete the lane-specific Codex home and run-local HOME/PYTHONUSERBASE/XDG/TMPDIR before each run; verify no stale indexes or generated profile files survive.

registry_entry.notes: Canonical Codex CLI no-MCP substrate baseline. Codex native shell/edit/file/git/verifier operations are allowed; MCP, retrieval, compression, memory, token-saving add-ons, global instructions, hooks, skills/plugins, and warm indexes are forbidden.

network_isolation.model_shell_enforcement: seccomp denies AF_INET and AF_INET6 socket creation for the shell process and descendants

runtime.isolation_policy: fresh lane-specific Codex home/tool data; provider-only network with model shell and Codex web search disabled; sequential one-task prompt delivery; controller seed/verifier and acceptance commands excluded; no acceptance assets injected

baseline_pool_reference.comparison_policy: paired baseline and treatment must share this baseline pool fingerprint and replicate

task_sequence.reset_policy: reset source checkout, profile home, tool state, indexes, caches, generated config, and agent home before the lane; preserve repository, thread, tool, index, cache, and agent state across every sequential prompt

leakage_controls.model_writable_surface: target repository plus isolated model-output directory
remaining_limitations: Future semantic regression code is present from lane start. Agent prompts state normal software objectives and do not disclose controller scoring. Compile, essential-smoke, and controller verifier commands remain controller-only; no acceptance-test assets are injected.
Task semantics and verifier names may still be searchable if the model intentionally uses external network access.

persist_between_tasks: repository source working tree and model-facing Git metadata from one composite broken-start root
memory/state stores enabled by the active profile

cumulative_token_usage.agent_step_definition: count of completed agent items (agent_message, command_execution, file_change, todo_list)
cumulative_token_usage.accounting_basis: Codex CLI telemetry; the sole evaluation metric is weighted token cost

software_quality.project_compile_command: find lib -type f -name '*.js' -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 -n1 node --check && node --check fastify.js

artifacts.final_diff_basis: ordered cumulative checkpoints plus final cumulative source diff from one composite root

interpretation.notes: Provider-backed lane completed with clean integrity; task acceptance and broader review outcomes do not gate weighted-token sample retention.
interpretation.scope_note: Full warm-state lane; all regressions are preseeded, prompts are disclosed sequentially, and controller verification runs only after the final prompt; declared acceptance assertions remain model-visible.
